Topic 10.2: Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo ni somo la kusoma: Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi. Soma maelezo, fuata mifano iliyofanyiwa kazi, kisha fanya mazoezi.

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi
3. Practise Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi at school and at home

SEHEMU 3: SOMO (MAELEZO NA MIFANO)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: KUSOMA 10.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA USHAIRI KATIKA SHAIRI
This lesson teaches Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi for Grade 9 KISWAHILI.

STUDY STEPS
1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. Practise Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi at school and at home
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO YA HARAKA

Example 1: Describe Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: MAZOEZI

1. Underline the key ideas about Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi above.
2. Explain Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi.

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA NYUMBANI

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. Explain the main ideas in Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi
2. Give Kenyan examples for Kusoma 10.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi katika shairi
